summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Demo Role Switcher feature - all functionality working correctly including role switching, permissions, toast notifications, and persistence
passed_tests: Demo Mode login works perfectly via 'Enter Demo Mode' button
Demo User shows DEMO badge with sparkles icon in user info
Demo User starts with Administrator role (full access) by default
Demo Role Switcher section appears in sidebar with purple sparkles icon
Demo Role Switcher dropdown shows all 4 roles with proper icons and descriptions
All 4 roles available: Administrator, Fraud Analyst, Security Engineer, Compliance Officer
Role switching to Analyst shows lock icons on RSB Manager, Diff Viewer, Rules, Approvals
Role switching to Engineer shows lock icons on Evidence Packs, Approvals
Role switching to Compliance shows lock icons on War Room, Brain Surgery, RSB Manager, Diff Viewer, Rules
Role switching to Administrator removes all lock icons (full access)
Toast notification displays correctly when switching roles: 'Switched to [Role Name] role'
Role selection persists after page refresh using localStorage
Regular users do NOT see the Demo Role Switcher (only demo users)
Role-based access control working - restricted pages show 'Restricted Access' message
Navigation items show proper lock icons based on current role permissions
Demo role switcher only visible for demo@fraudforge.io users
All backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate - 35/35 tests passed)
No console errors or JavaScript exceptions during role switching
UI is responsive and all interactive elements are clickable
Role descriptions show correct permissions for each role type
